contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.emptyHint: Save the addresses you use often — no more re-pasting when you send. You can also import an existing address book from a file.
contacts.deleteBody: {{name}} will be removed from your address book.
contacts.groupNoContacts: Save some contacts first, then group them here.
contacts.groupDeleteBody: The group “{{name}}” will be deleted. Its contacts stay in your address book.
contacts.exportBody: Choose a format to back up your address book.
contacts.importFailBody: Use a JSON or CSV contacts file.
contacts.importFailEncoding: Save the file as UTF-8 (Excel: CSV UTF-8) and try again.
contacts.importFailEmpty: This file has no contacts in it.
contacts.batchSendHint: Send to all {{count}} members — amounts can be set individually.
contacts.batchSendHintTitled: Send to group: pay all {{count}} members — amounts can be set individually.
contacts.batchSendNeedsMembers: Add a member first — a group send needs someone to send to.
contacts.invalidChecksum: The capital letters in this address don't match its checksum — a typo, or a copy that was altered. Check it and copy it again.
contacts.duplicateAddress: Already saved as “{{name}}”. Saving updates that contact.
contacts.groupPickEmpty: No groups yet. Create a group first, then move contacts into it.
contacts.saveFailed: Couldn't save to this device. Your change shows here, but it will be gone when you close the page.
contacts.batchSendHintCount_one: Send to {{count}} member — amounts can be set individually.
contacts.batchSendHintCount_other: Send to all {{count}} members — amounts can be set individually.
contacts.batchSendHintTitledCount_one: Send to group: pay {{count}} member — amounts can be set individually.
